verdict.rationale: Clerky ships a Partner API and a remote MCP server, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask, but no evidence documents a sandbox, test mode, or non-production environment. The MCP server's read-only, team-scoped access is an adjacent control, not sandbox isolation from production data, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
